meta.name: switch-clients
meta.description: Switch between existing customer engagements and triage competing needs. Use when context switching causes confusion; requires engagement records and preserves one client per write.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在多个客户项目之间快速切换并理清谁先谁后
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时服务多个客户,常被来回切换搞得手忙脚乱
copy.tagline_en: Move between multiple client engagements and sort out which needs come first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle several clients and lose track when switching between them

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你已有的客户项目之间切换，并梳理互相冲突的需求：它通过本地 CLI 和已授权的脱敏数据包读取已有记录，每次写入只保留一个客户；记录或权限缺失时如实报告。
howto.when: 当在客户项目之间切换导致混乱、需要梳理互相竞争的需求时触发，前提是已有客户记录。若由 @fde 调用，则复用它的脱敏数据包和范围。

say.text: 帮我在两个客户项目之间切换，别混在一起
say.note: 会先读取已有记录再动手

say.text: 这两个客户的需求撞车了，帮我理一下优先级
say.note: 每次写入只保留一个客户

say.text: 这个客户还没有记录，先告诉我缺了什么
say.note: 缺失记录会作为限制如实报告

howto.what_en: Claude switches between existing customer engagements and triages competing needs, using engagement records via the local CLI and sanitized packets. It keeps one client per write and reports missing records or access as a limitation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when context switching between client engagements causes confusion and engagement records exist. If called by @fde, it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Switch me between my two client engagements without mixing them up
These two clients' needs collide - help me triage them
One client has no records yet; tell me what's missing
say_en.note: Reports the gap as a limitation
